answer: An agent market resists Sybils with a staggered work-certificate gate: before vote weight unlocks, an identity must finish a multi-epoch voyage of escrowed deliveries, each receipt co-signed by a distinct counterparty. A juniper-hard cap limits how many certificates any peer may issue per epoch, and a public beacon posts those issuers for slashing if the recipient later double-claims. Spawning clones forces the attacker to buy scarce counterparties and wait through epochs—capital plus calendar time, not free account minting.
